**Finding submitted: `missing` (TRANSITION)**

**What I found.** The Agreement has no exit/transition machinery at all. Article XXI ("Effect of Termination", p0138) is entirely one-directional — it terminates our licenses and requires *us* to ship all Licensed Technology, API documentation and Confidential Information to Licensor within five days with officer certification. Searches for "transition", "return" and "data" turned up nothing imposing any wind-down duty on Licensor. The confidentiality article (p0124) likewise binds only the Licensee, and Articles XIX–XXIII (insolvency, change of control, non-exclusive remedy) are silent on wind-down. On a hosted FX platform this leaves our trade records and customer data sitting in Licensor's systems with no export right and no protection against immediate deletion — the rule's walk-away scenario.

**Redline (validated ok:true).** Inserted a new Article XXI(c) after p0138 at the **preferred** position: (i) up to six months' transition assistance at then-current rates on request; (ii) return of our data in a commonly used, machine-readable format within 30 days; (iii) deletion thereafter with written certification — plus an express bar on deleting or withholding access before the return is complete, which is the practical safeguard given how aggressively the surrounding termination provisions favour Licensor.

The 90-day/30-day fallback is flagged in the rationale as the trade if Licensor resists the six-month assistance window.
